contentCheck.notes: Crop shows the full stem and Lewis diagrams A-D (CF4, NF3, SO3, SO2) with lone pairs shown.

primary.evidence: Must compare bond angles across the four molecules and recognize that lone-pair repulsion compresses angles below the ideal values for the electron-domain geometry.

supporting.evidence: Must count electron domains around each central atom, counting the S=O double bond as one domain and each lone pair as one, to tell tetrahedral (NF3, CF4) from trigonal planar (SO3, SO2) arrangements.
